annotations.title: chainpeek: chain id, latest block, head age and gas price of Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain

description: chainpeek: Get the chain id, latest block, head age and gas price of Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain. For gas alone use get_gas; for the header alone use get_block. Returns `chain_id`, the latest `block_number` and `block_timestamp`, `head_age_s` (seconds since the head block, a liveness check), `gas_price_gwei`, `base_fee_gwei`, and the block's gas used and limit. Three RPC reads. Ethereum, Base and Robinhood only; read-only: nothing is signed or sent. RPC reads are cached up to 30 s. A bad address, hash, hex string, block or range is a 422 before any payment (not charged). Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/ethereum-rpc-reads-api.html
